main.description: Removes a member from a community. The member may rejoin unless the community requires approval to join.

community.description: The community to remove the member from.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the member.kick permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at the given DID.

errors.name: MemberNotFound
errors.description: The subject does not hold a member record in this community.

errors.name: RoleHierarchy
errors.description: The subject holds a role at or above the caller's highest role position.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView cannot act as the community because its stored credentials are missing or unusable.
